description: This file contains SQL scripts to set up a 'projects' table in a PostgreSQL database, including schema definition, extension setup, and permissive row-level security policies for development/testing environments.
calls: create extension if not exists pgcrypto
alter table public.projects enable row level security
drop policy if exists "Allow select for all (dev)" on public.projects
drop policy if exists "Allow insert for all (dev)" on public.projects
